title: Federal award transaction obligations by primary place of performance, FY2025
method: Preserve USAspending API's published sum of federal action obligations, scoped to primary place of performance by state, filtered to FY2025 transaction action date and spending_level transactions. Preserve negative adjustments and exact source amount string; no per-capita transformations or derived causal outcomes.
warnings: Obligations are not federal outlays, expenditures, grant effectiveness, or economic benefits delivered.
Place of performance does not necessarily identify where a transaction's benefits accrue.
Transactions may be revised by agencies after the reported fiscal year.
